property_summary: For any block number divisible by 15 and any actor, a valid 10-ether fallback call drains the contract so address(c).balance becomes 0; the mutant pays on number%15==1 instead, leaving the balance nonzero at such blocks.
change_summary: Change the payout condition from block.number % 15 == 0 to block.number % 15 == 1, altering when funds are transferred.
